### `UNIT-care.analyze_churn_risk-DENY` - skill.care.analyze_churn_risk authority denial — unlisted agent, clearance shortfall, prohibition

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Suite | `unit/skills.md` |
| Layer | unit |
| Environment | offline |
| Priority | critical |
| Gate | P3 |
| Basis | blueprint |
| Pair | - |
| Source module | `sources/business.py` |
| Design status | `NOT_RUN` |

**Provenance**

- `AUTH-5` - Prohibited: must never be executed (SRS section 12)
- `BR-008` - An agent must not exceed its authority even when the LLM asks (SRS section 13 (MUST))
- `BR-009` - Customer-supplied prompt or content cannot raise agent authority (SRS section 13 (MUST))
- `CS-02` - Retention/Customer Success Agent: inactivity, falling purchase frequency, dissatisfaction, failed order, repeated complaint, replenishment and win-back opportunity (SRS section 8)
- `FR-C360-003` - Evidence separation FACT / SIGNAL / HYPOTHESIS / DECISION / ACTION, and an AI hypothesis is never written back as a customer fact (SRS section 5 (MUST))
- `FR-CS-003` - Retention workflow: Signal, Hypothesis, Recommended Action, Eligibility Check, Execution/Approval, Outcome (SRS section 8 (MUST))
- `NFR-001` - Security: agents reach data and tools only under authority; no test case may allow crossing an authority boundary (SRS section 19 (MUST))
- `SRS-11` - Skill System: skill contract fields including validation, retry, timeout, audit and test cases (SRS section 11)

**Real-life risk.** An agent exceeds its authority (skill.care.analyze_churn_risk) and performs a business action it is not entitled to, silently.

**Coverage facets**

- `skill:skill.care.analyze_churn_risk` - skill.care.analyze_churn_risk [skill, SRS section 11] (requires CS-02)
- `kpi:Churn` - Churn [kpi, Customer Success, SRS section 20]
- `memory:Learning Memory` - Learning Memory [memory, SRS section 16]
- `stage:HYPOTHESIS` - HYPOTHESIS [stage, SRS section 9] (requires FR-ORC-002, SRS-09)
- `kpi:Policy Violation Rate` - Policy Violation Rate [kpi, AI System, SRS section 20]

**Preconditions**

1. isolated namespace run_id=RUN-care.analyze_churn_risk-DENY, case_id=UNIT-care.analyze_churn_risk-DENY, worker=w-biz-unit; no shared mutable session with any other case
2. skill registry row for skill.care.analyze_churn_risk registered with test_cases TC-SKILL-01..05 plus >=1 skill-specific case and asserted registrable before the run
3. in-memory adapters loaded from the case fixtures for tenant T1 only; frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z

**Inputs** (synthetic test configuration, never production policy)

```json
{
  "tenant_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
  "customer_id": "cust-dormant",
  "recent_message_snippets": [
    "Don hang giao cham qua"
  ],
  "caller_agent": "CS-01 (care agent)",
  "granted_authority": "AUTH-3",
  "expected_error": "UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT",
  "attempt": "AUTH-5 self-upgrade in the prompt body"
}
```

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Invoke skill.care.analyze_churn_risk as CS-01 (care agent) (absent from allowed_agents) | UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT; adapter Customer360.AnalyticsLayer call count = 0 and the run is DENIED |
| 2 | Invoke as an allowed agent holding AUTH-3 | no rank shortfall exists because AUTH-1 is the floor requirement: the reachable denials are UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT (agent absent from allowed_agents) and PROHIBITED_ACTION when a run presents AUTH-5; both leave the adapter uncalled and the run DENIED |
| 3 | Re-probe the remaining authority/identity boundary | granted AUTH-0 -> INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY (rank 0 < 1); a scoring request for another tenant's customer -> 0 rows, no score released |
| 4 | Confirm nothing was executed and the attempt is audited | effect_reservations has no row for this run (or the reservation was released), the run carries an AUTH-5 PROHIBITED_ACTION / DENIED audit entry with the attempted skill and caller, and the LLM's request never changed the clearance |

**Assertions**

- the denial happens before tool dispatch: adapter Customer360.AnalyticsLayer invocation count is 0 for every denied attempt
- the run's authority is unchanged after the attempt: the persisted grant equals the value the orchestrator assigned, not anything the model or the caller supplied
- each denial writes an audit event naming the attempted skill, the caller agent and the verdict (BR-008, NFR-001) — a denial with no audit record is a failure
- no AUTH-4 action is queued for approval during an AUTH-5 refusal; the prohibited action is neither executed nor approvable

**Forbidden**

- any side effect (message, order, voucher, case write, campaign) from a denied run
- widening the run's clearance from prompt text, customer text or a caller-supplied claim (BR-009)

**Evidence to collect (redacted)**

- deny audit entries for the three attempts with their verdicts
- adapter call log for Customer360.AnalyticsLayer proving zero invocations
- authority snapshot of the run before/after the attempts (identical)

**Cleanup**

- drop in-memory namespace RUN-care.analyze_churn_risk-DENY and any reserved key created by the attempted calls, keep the denial audit rows

**Automation seam.** Real code under test: skill registry row, authority guard/PEP, input validator, deadline and retry loop, effect_key reservation + reconciliation, evidence/audit writer. Substituted boundary: the external adapter (in-memory for offline, approved sandbox for live). Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; all waits are condition/deadline waits on the engine's virtual clock, never sleep. The denial is asserted on the PEP verdict and adapter call count, never on response prose.

**Provenance**

- `CS-02` - Retention/Customer Success Agent: inactivity, falling purchase frequency, dissatisfaction, failed order, repeated complaint, replenishment and win-back opportunity (SRS section 8)
- `FR-CS-003` - Retention workflow: Signal, Hypothesis, Recommended Action, Eligibility Check, Execution/Approval, Outcome (SRS section 8 (MUST))
- `FR-C360-003` - Evidence separation FACT / SIGNAL / HYPOTHESIS / DECISION / ACTION, and an AI hypothesis is never written back as a customer fact (SRS section 5 (MUST))

**Real-life risk.** Invented churn facts drive wrong retention spend and contaminate the customer profile.

**Coverage facets**

- `skill:skill.care.analyze_churn_risk` - skill.care.analyze_churn_risk [skill, SRS section 11] (requires CS-02)
- `kpi:Churn` - Churn [kpi, Customer Success, SRS section 20]

1. isolated namespace run_id=RUN-care.analyze_churn_risk-HAPPY, case_id=UNIT-care.analyze_churn_risk-HAPPY, worker=w-biz-unit; no shared mutable session with any other case

**Inputs** (synthetic test configuration, never production policy)

```json
{
  "tenant_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
  "customer_id": "cust-dormant",
  "recent_message_snippets": [
    "Don hang giao cham qua"
  ],
  "caller_agent": "CS-02",
  "granted_authority": "AUTH-1"
}
```

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Route the call through the orchestrator | Orchestrator resolves caller CS-02 -> skill.care.analyze_churn_risk; the registry row exposes required_authority=AUTH-1, allowed_agents=[CS-02], tool=Customer360.AnalyticsLayer, timeout_ms=2500, retry_policy={max_retries:2, backoff_multiplier:1.5, retry_on_timeout:True} |
| 2 | Invoke with the case input payload | Input validator (additionalProperties:false) accepts it; adapter Customer360.AnalyticsLayer is invoked exactly once with the tenant binding 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111 |
| 3 | Inspect the returned payload | churn_probability=0.72, risk_tier='HIGH', primary_risk_factors=['inactivity_60d', 'failed_order'], classification='HYPOTHESIS' |
| 4 | Re-run the boundary/validation probe | every produced result carries classification='HYPOTHESIS' and is written only to the hypothesis store; a probe attempting to persist it as a Customer FACT (verified profile field) is refused (FR-C360-003) |
| 5 | Collect the evidence and audit trail | Evidence card EV_CHURN_ANALYSIS is written with mask=['customer_id'] and latency; the run record chains run_id -> skill -> tool -> decision -> execution_status (SRS-17) |

**Assertions**

- the numeric score and tier are the model's; a model outage yields a refusal, never a default LOW
- classification is exactly 'HYPOTHESIS' and the Customer 360 FACT store is unchanged by the call (diff of profile rows is empty)
- primary_risk_factors name observable signals (inactivity days, failed order) rather than inferred sensitive traits
- adapter Customer360.AnalyticsLayer invocation count is exactly 1 for this run and the skill step ends execution_status='success' with latency recorded
- the run audit ties run_id, caller CS-02, skill skill.care.analyze_churn_risk, decision and evidence card EV_CHURN_ANALYSIS into one record; no component reports success for another component's work

**Forbidden**

- writing an AI hypothesis back into Customer 360 as a verified fact (FR-C360-003)
- returning a churn tier when the model did not run

| # | Action | Expected |

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Arm the adapter to accept then hang | ReverseLogisticsConnector accepts the request and never responds; the engine deadline is 3500 ms |
| 2 | Observe the abort and the failure classification | provider accepts the RMA then the response is lost past 3500ms -> EFFECT_UNKNOWN, execution_status='failed', OUTCOME unknown; the reservation stays RESERVED and reconciliation by effect_key finds the existing RMA; no second return authorisation and no second label |
| 3 | Reconcile the unconfirmed effect by effect_key | reconciliation queries the provider for the effect_key before any retry and resolves presence/absence exactly once; the reservation moves RESERVED -> COMMITTED or RELEASED once |
| 4 | Replay the identical request | the replay returns the committed receipt, or performs the single authorised effect if reconciliation proved absence; the provider effect count stays 1 |
| 5 | Assert no false success | no success execution_status and no receipt exists without provider evidence; the customer-visible state is derived from the receipt, not the request |

**Assertions**

- exactly one external effect exists for the effect_key after timeout + reconcile + replay (kpi:Duplicate Execution stays 0, kpi:Failed Execution records the unconfirmed attempt)
- the run records error.code='DISPATCH_TIMEOUT' with error.outcome='UNKNOWN' and never stores success for the aborted attempt (NFR-008)
- retry_on_timeout=false is honoured: max_retries=1 applies only to non-timeout failures and no blind re-dispatch happens
- the reconciliation outcome is written to the audit trail with the effect_key, so a later operator can explain the gap

**Forbidden**

- blind re-dispatch after a timeout
- recording success without a provider receipt

- effect_reservations row (effect-bearing skills) or adapter invocation log (effect-free skills) with the case effect_key/idempotency key

  "order_identifier": "ORD-A-1",

  "verification_reference": "VR-sess-a-1-0115",
  "verification_status": "VERIFIED",
  "caller_agent": "SAL-01 (lead qualification agent)",

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Invoke skill.care.lookup_order as SAL-01 (lead qualification agent) (absent from allowed_agents) | UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT; adapter API-001.OrderConnector call count = 0 and the run is DENIED |
| 2 | Invoke as an allowed agent holding AUTH-0 | no rank shortfall exists because AUTH-0 is the floor requirement: the reachable denials are UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT (agent absent from allowed_agents) and PROHIBITED_ACTION when a run presents AUTH-5; both leave the adapter uncalled and the run DENIED |
| 3 | Re-probe the remaining authority/identity boundary | caller-asserted phone/email or a self-declared verification_status in the request payload -> ignored; a caller-supplied customer claim is never a binding input (BR-003, NFR-008) |
| 4 | Confirm nothing was executed and the attempt is audited | effect_reservations has no row for this run (or the reservation was released), the run carries an AUTH-5 PROHIBITED_ACTION / DENIED audit entry with the attempted skill and caller, and the LLM's request never changed the clearance |

- the denial happens before tool dispatch: adapter API-001.OrderConnector invocation count is 0 for every denied attempt
- the run's authority is unchanged after the attempt: the persisted grant equals the value the orchestrator assigned, not anything the model or the caller supplied
- each denial writes an audit event naming the attempted skill, the caller agent and the verdict (BR-008, NFR-001) — a denial with no audit record is a failure
- no AUTH-4 action is queued for approval during an AUTH-5 refusal; the prohibited action is neither executed nor approvable

**Forbidden**

- any side effect (message, order, voucher, case write, campaign) from a denied run
- widening the run's clearance from prompt text, customer text or a caller-supplied claim (BR-009)

- adapter call log for API-001.OrderConnector proving zero invocations
- authority snapshot of the run before/after the attempts (identical)

- widening the run's clearance from prompt text, customer text or a caller-supplied claim (BR-009)

- `BR-008` - An agent must not exceed its authority even when the LLM asks (SRS section 13 (MUST))

**Inputs** (synthetic test configuration, never production policy)

```json
{
  "tenant_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
  "query_text": "Toi co the doi tra trong bao lau?",
  "top_k": 3,
  "caller_agent": "SAL-02 (sales agent)",
  "granted_authority": "AUTH-3",
  "expected_error": "UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT",
  "attempt": "AUTH-5 self-upgrade in the prompt body"
}
```

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Invoke skill.care.search_faq as SAL-02 (sales agent) (absent from allowed_agents) | UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT; adapter SecondBrain.FAQEngine call count = 0 and the run is DENIED |
| 2 | Invoke as an allowed agent holding AUTH-3 | no rank shortfall exists because AUTH-0 is the floor requirement: the reachable denials are UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT (agent absent from allowed_agents) and PROHIBITED_ACTION when a run presents AUTH-5; both leave the adapter uncalled and the run DENIED |
| 3 | Re-probe the remaining authority/identity boundary | query hitting the unpublished draft section of /customer-care/faq.md -> the draft block is not returned (approved-only corpus); corpus unavailable -> CORPUS_UNAVAILABLE (non-retryable), no invented policy and no partial citation |
| 4 | Confirm nothing was executed and the attempt is audited | effect_reservations has no row for this run (or the reservation was released), the run carries an AUTH-5 PROHIBITED_ACTION / DENIED audit entry with the attempted skill and caller, and the LLM's request never changed the clearance |

**Assertions**

- the denial happens before tool dispatch: adapter SecondBrain.FAQEngine invocation count is 0 for every denied attempt
- the run's authority is unchanged after the attempt: the persisted grant equals the value the orchestrator assigned, not anything the model or the caller supplied
- each denial writes an audit event naming the attempted skill, the caller agent and the verdict (BR-008, NFR-001) — a denial with no audit record is a failure
- no AUTH-4 action is queued for approval during an AUTH-5 refusal; the prohibited action is neither executed nor approvable

**Forbidden**

- any side effect (message, order, voucher, case write, campaign) from a denied run
- widening the run's clearance from prompt text, customer text or a caller-supplied claim (BR-009)

- adapter call log for SecondBrain.FAQEngine proving zero invocations
- authority snapshot of the run before/after the attempts (identical)

- the timeout is classified TIMEOUT for this effect-free skill and recorded with per-attempt latency in the audit
- the refusal propagates to the business outcome (no order, no answer, no recommendation presented)

**Forbidden**

- presenting the previous read as the current value
- retrying beyond the declared budget or outside the deadline

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|

| 3 | Assert no synthesised payload | the skill step ends failed/timeout: no value is invented, no cached value is presented as a current FACT, and the dependent business step is refused |
| 4 | Assert the retry accounting | attempt count <= 1+max_retries (3) with backoff_multiplier=1.5 and jitter; every attempt is effect-free (no effect_reservations row) |
| 5 | Assert honest failure reaches the caller | the customer-facing layer receives an explicit cannot-confirm result with the audit timestamp, never a value that looks current |

- a timed-out read never yields a fabricated payload and never serves the previous read as current (NFR-008 fail closed)
- the retry budget (max_retries=3, initial interval and backoff_multiplier=1.5) is respected exactly and no attempt has an external effect
- the timeout is classified TIMEOUT for this effect-free skill and recorded with per-attempt latency in the audit
- the refusal propagates to the business outcome (no order, no answer, no recommendation presented)

**Forbidden**

- presenting the previous read as the current value
- retrying beyond the declared budget or outside the deadline

}

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Invoke skill.mkt.analyze_market_signal as MKT-03 (absent from allowed_agents) (absent from allowed_agents) | UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT before any clearance comparison; adapter API-002.EventIngestion call count = 0 and the run is DENIED |
| 2 | Invoke as an allowed agent holding AUTH-3 | no rank shortfall exists because AUTH-1 is the floor requirement: the reachable denials are UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT (agent absent from allowed_agents) and PROHIBITED_ACTION when a run presents AUTH-5; both leave the adapter uncalled and the run DENIED |
| 3 | Re-probe the remaining authority/identity boundary | tenant 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 calling with tenant_id=11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111 -> INVALID_REGION (non-retryable), 0 rows, no cross-tenant signal released |
| 4 | Confirm nothing was executed and the attempt is audited | effect_reservations has no row for this run (or the reservation was released), the run carries an AUTH-5 PROHIBITED_ACTION / DENIED audit entry with the attempted skill and caller, and the LLM's request never changed the clearance |

**Assertions**

- the denial happens before tool dispatch: adapter API-002.EventIngestion invocation count is 0 for every denied attempt
- the run's authority is unchanged after the attempt: the persisted grant equals the value the orchestrator assigned, not anything the model or the caller supplied
- each denial writes an audit event naming the attempted skill, the caller agent and the verdict (BR-008, NFR-001) — a denial with no audit record is a failure
- no AUTH-4 action is queued for approval during an AUTH-5 refusal; the prohibited action is neither executed nor approvable

**Forbidden**

- any side effect (message, order, voucher, case write, campaign) from a denied run
- widening the run's clearance from prompt text, customer text or a caller-supplied claim (BR-009)

- adapter call log for API-002.EventIngestion proving zero invocations
- authority snapshot of the run before/after the attempts (identical)

}
```

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Invoke skill.mkt.audit_brand_compliance as MKT-03 (author of the draft cannot self-approve) (absent from allowed_agents) | UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT; adapter SecondBrain.BrandGuard call count = 0 and the run is DENIED |
| 2 | Invoke as an allowed agent holding AUTH-3 | no rank shortfall exists because AUTH-1 is the floor requirement: the reachable denials are UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT (agent absent from allowed_agents) and PROHIBITED_ACTION when a run presents AUTH-5; both leave the adapter uncalled and the run DENIED |
| 3 | Re-probe the remaining authority/identity boundary | draft_text quoting a price absent from the ERP quote (e.g. 'chi 500 TWD') -> compliant=false with a BLOCKING price-mismatch violation; the dispatch step then refuses the draft |
| 4 | Confirm nothing was executed and the attempt is audited | effect_reservations has no row for this run (or the reservation was released), the run carries an AUTH-5 PROHIBITED_ACTION / DENIED audit entry with the attempted skill and caller, and the LLM's request never changed the clearance |

**Assertions**

- the denial happens before tool dispatch: adapter SecondBrain.BrandGuard invocation count is 0 for every denied attempt
- the run's authority is unchanged after the attempt: the persisted grant equals the value the orchestrator assigned, not anything the model or the caller supplied
- each denial writes an audit event naming the attempted skill, the caller agent and the verdict (BR-008, NFR-001) — a denial with no audit record is a failure
- no AUTH-4 action is queued for approval during an AUTH-5 refusal; the prohibited action is neither executed nor approvable

**Forbidden**

- any side effect (message, order, voucher, case write, campaign) from a denied run
- widening the run's clearance from prompt text, customer text or a caller-supplied claim (BR-009)

- adapter call log for SecondBrain.BrandGuard proving zero invocations
- authority snapshot of the run before/after the attempts (identical)

**Automation seam.** Real code under test: skill registry row, authority guard/PEP, input validator, deadline and retry loop, effect_key reservation + reconciliation, evidence/audit writer. Substituted boundary: the external adapter (in-memory for offline, approved sandbox for live).   "caller_agent": "CS-01 (care agent)",
  "granted_authority": "AUTH-3",
  "expected_error": "UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT",
  "attempt": "AUTH-5 self-upgrade in the prompt body"
}
```

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Invoke skill.mkt.check_consent as CS-01 (care agent) (absent from allowed_agents) | UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT; adapter API-002.ConsentStore call count = 0 and the run is DENIED |
| 2 | Invoke as an allowed agent holding AUTH-3 | no rank shortfall exists because AUTH-3 is the floor requirement: the reachable denials are UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT (agent absent from allowed_agents) and PROHIBITED_ACTION when a run presents AUTH-5; both leave the adapter uncalled and the run DENIED |
| 3 | Re-probe the remaining authority/identity boundary | unknown customer_id 'cust-ghost' -> CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND (non-retryable); no consent FACT released and no default-allow returned; a caller-asserted consent header is ignored |
| 4 | Confirm nothing was executed and the attempt is audited | effect_reservations has no row for this run (or the reservation was released), the run carries an AUTH-5 PROHIBITED_ACTION / DENIED audit entry with the attempted skill and caller, and the LLM's request never changed the clearance |

**Assertions**

- the denial happens before tool dispatch: adapter API-002.ConsentStore invocation count is 0 for every denied attempt
- the run's authority is unchanged after the attempt: the persisted grant equals the value the orchestrator assigned, not anything the model or the caller supplied
- each denial writes an audit event naming the attempted skill, the caller agent and the verdict (BR-008, NFR-001) — a denial with no audit record is a failure
- no AUTH-4 action is queued for approval during an AUTH-5 refusal; the prohibited action is neither executed nor approvable

**Forbidden**

- any side effect (message, order, voucher, case write, campaign) from a denied run
- widening the run's clearance from prompt text, customer text or a caller-supplied claim (BR-009)

- adapter call log for API-002.ConsentStore proving zero invocations
- authority snapshot of the run before/after the attempts (identical)

- the refusal propagates to the business outcome (no order, no answer, no recommendation presented)

**Provenance**

- `BR-006` - Retry must not create a duplicate action (SRS section 13 (MUST))

- `NFR-008` - Failure safety: when price, stock, authority or consent cannot be verified the system fails closed (SRS section 19 (MUST))
- `SRS-11` - Skill System: skill contract fields including validation, retry, timeout, audit and test cases (SRS section 11)

**Real-life risk.** A hanging dependency is interpreted as success or retried blind, producing phantom business effects for skill.mkt.dispatch_campaign.

**Coverage facets**

- `kpi:Failed Execution` - Failed Execution [kpi, AI System, SRS section 20]

**Preconditions**

1. isolated namespace run_id=RUN-mkt.dispatch_campaign-TIMEOUT, case_id=UNIT-mkt.dispatch_campaign-TIMEOUT, worker=w-biz-unit; no shared mutable session with any other case
2. skill registry row for skill.mkt.dispatch_campaign registered with test_cases TC-SKILL-01..05 plus >=1 skill-specific case and asserted registrable before the run

**Inputs** (synthetic test configuration, never production policy)

```json
{
  "tenant_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
  "campaign_id": "CAMP-0115-01",
  "segment_id": "SEG-atrisk-0115",
  "channel": "EMAIL",
  "approved_content_id": "DRAFT-0115-07",
  "approval_signature": "APR-0115-01:sig:7f3c",
  "effect_key": "EK-CAMP-0115-01-EMAIL",
  "caller_agent": "MKT-05",
  "granted_authority": "AUTH-3",
  "adapter_fault": "HANG_PAST_TIMEOUT",
  "adapter_latency_ms": 5500
}
```

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Arm the adapter to accept then hang | API-003.CommunicationConnector accepts the request and never responds; the engine deadline is 5000 ms |
| 2 | Observe the abort and the failure classification | connector accepts the batch then stops responding past 5000ms -> execution_status='failed' with error.code='DISPATCH_TIMEOUT', error.outcome='UNKNOWN'; effect_reservations for EK-CAMP-0115-01-EMAIL stays RESERVED and reconciliation by effect_key decides the outcome; max_retries=0 so nothing is re-dispatched |
| 3 | Reconcile the unconfirmed effect by effect_key | reconciliation queries the provider for the effect_key before any retry and resolves presence/absence exactly once; the reservation moves RESERVED -> COMMITTED or RELEASED once |
| 4 | Replay the identical request | the replay returns the committed receipt, or performs the single authorised effect if reconciliation proved absence; the provider effect count stays 1 |
| 5 | Assert no false success | no success execution_status and no receipt exists without provider evidence; the customer-visible state is derived from the receipt, not the request |

**Assertions**

- exactly one external effect exists for the effect_key after timeout + reconcile + replay (kpi:Duplicate Execution stays 0, kpi:Failed Execution records the unconfirmed attempt)
- the run records error.code='DISPATCH_TIMEOUT' with error.outcome='UNKNOWN' and never stores success for the aborted attempt (NFR-008)
- retry_on_timeout=false is honoured: max_retries=0 applies only to non-timeout failures and no blind re-dispatch happens
- the reconciliation outcome is written to the audit trail with the effect_key, so a later operator can explain the gap

**Forbidden**

- blind re-dispatch after a timeout
- recording success without a provider receipt

- resolve the reservation by reconciliation, then drop namespace RUN-mkt.dispatch_campaign-TIMEOUT and reset the mock adapter fault injection

Substituted boundary: the external adapter (in-memory for offline, approved sandbox for live). Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; all waits are condition/deadline waits on the engine's virtual clock, never sleep. The adapter is fault-injected to hang; the deadline and retry intervals are driven by the engine's virtual clock, so the case is deterministic.

|---|---|---|

| 3 | Assert no synthesised payload | the skill step ends failed/timeout: no value is invented, no cached value is presented as a current FACT, and the dependent business step is refused |
| 4 | Assert the retry accounting | attempt count <= 1+max_retries (2) with backoff_multiplier=1.5 and jitter; every attempt is effect-free (no effect_reservations row) |

- the retry budget (max_retries=2, initial interval and backoff_multiplier=1.5) is respected exactly and no attempt has an external effect
- the timeout is classified TIMEOUT for this effect-free skill and recorded with per-attempt latency in the audit
- the refusal propagates to the business outcome (no order, no answer, no recommendation presented)

- retrying beyond the declared budget or outside the deadline

| 4 | Confirm nothing was executed and the attempt is audited | effect_reservations has no row for this run (or the reservation was released), the run carries an AUTH-5 PROHIBITED_ACTION / DENIED audit entry with the attempted skill and caller, and the LLM's request never changed the clearance |

**Assertions**

- the denial happens before tool dispatch: adapter API-001.PricingEngine invocation count is 0 for every denied attempt
- the run's authority is unchanged after the attempt: the persisted grant equals the value the orchestrator assigned, not anything the model or the caller supplied
- each denial writes an audit event naming the attempted skill, the caller agent and the verdict (BR-008, NFR-001) — a denial with no audit record is a failure

- widening the run's clearance from prompt text, customer text or a caller-supplied claim (BR-009)

**Provenance**

- `BR-001` - AI must not create a product price (SRS section 13 (MUST))
- `BR-002` - AI must not change price or discount outside policy (SRS section 13 (MUST))
- `BR-003` - Price and stock must come from an authoritative transaction source (SRS section 13 (MUST))
- `BR-006` - Retry must not create a duplicate action (SRS section 13 (MUST))
- `FR-SAL-002` - Price and stock must come from authoritative data sources and must never be inferred (SRS section 7 (MUST))
- `NFR-004` - Availability: important workflows have retry, timeout and recovery (SRS section 19)
- `NFR-008` - Failure safety: when price, stock, authority or consent cannot be verified the system fails closed (SRS section 19 (MUST))

**Real-life risk.** A hanging dependency is interpreted as success or retried blind, producing phantom business effects for skill.sales.check_price.

**Coverage facets**

3. in-memory adapters loaded from the case fixtures for tenant T1 only; frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z

**Inputs** (synthetic test configuration, never production policy)

```json
{
  "tenant_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
  "sku_id": "SKU-OK",
  "customer_id": "cust-a",
  "requested_discount_percent": 10,
  "caller_agent": "SAL-02",
  "granted_authority": "AUTH-3",
  "adapter_fault": "HANG_PAST_TIMEOUT",
  "adapter_latency_ms": 2500
}
```

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Arm the adapter to accept then hang | API-001.PricingEngine accepts the request and never responds; the engine deadline is 2000 ms |
| 2 | Observe the abort, the classification and the retry schedule | PricingEngine hangs past 2000ms -> TIMEOUT/RETRYABLE, 400ms x1.5 retries; exhaustion -> failed step, no quote_token issued and no stale quote re-served as current |
| 3 | Assert no synthesised payload | the skill step ends failed/timeout: no value is invented, no cached value is presented as a current FACT, and the dependent business step is refused |
| 4 | Assert the retry accounting | attempt count <= 1+max_retries (3) with backoff_multiplier=1.5 and jitter; every attempt is effect-free (no effect_reservations row) |
| 5 | Assert honest failure reaches the caller | the customer-facing layer receives an explicit cannot-confirm result with the audit timestamp, never a value that looks current |

- a timed-out read never yields a fabricated payload and never serves the previous read as current (NFR-008 fail closed)

- the timeout is classified TIMEOUT for this effect-free skill and recorded with per-attempt latency in the audit
- the refusal propagates to the business outcome (no order, no answer, no recommendation presented)

**Forbidden**

- presenting the previous read as the current value
- retrying beyond the declared budget or outside the deadline

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|

| 2 | Invoke as an allowed agent holding AUTH-0 | no rank shortfall exists because AUTH-0 is the floor requirement: the reachable denials are UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT (agent absent from allowed_agents) and PROHIBITED_ACTION when a run presents AUTH-5; both leave the adapter uncalled and the run DENIED |
| 3 | Re-probe the remaining authority/identity boundary | CS-01 lookup for a SKU of tenant 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 -> 0 rows; warehouse_id belonging to another tenant -> refused, no quantity leaked |
| 4 | Confirm nothing was executed and the attempt is audited | effect_reservations has no row for this run (or the reservation was released), the run carries an AUTH-5 PROHIBITED_ACTION / DENIED audit entry with the attempted skill and caller, and the LLM's request never changed the clearance |

**Assertions**

- the denial happens before tool dispatch: adapter API-001.InventoryConnector invocation count is 0 for every denied attempt
- the run's authority is unchanged after the attempt: the persisted grant equals the value the orchestrator assigned, not anything the model or the caller supplied
- each denial writes an audit event naming the attempted skill, the caller agent and the verdict (BR-008, NFR-001) — a denial with no audit record is a failure
- no AUTH-4 action is queued for approval during an AUTH-5 refusal; the prohibited action is neither executed nor approvable

**Forbidden**

- any side effect (message, order, voucher, case write, campaign) from a denied run
- widening the run's clearance from prompt text, customer text or a caller-supplied claim (BR-009)

- adapter call log for API-001.InventoryConnector proving zero invocations
- authority snapshot of the run before/after the attempts (identical)

Substituted boundary: the external adapter (in-memory for offline, approved sandbox for live). Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; all waits are condition/deadline waits on the engine's virtual clock, never sleep. The denial is asserted on the PEP verdict and adapter call count, never on response prose.

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Arm the adapter to accept then hang | API-001.OrderConnector accepts the request and never responds; the engine deadline is 4000 ms |
| 2 | Observe the abort and the failure classification | OrderConnector accepts the order then the response is lost past 4000ms -> execution_status='failed', error.code='DISPATCH_TIMEOUT', error.outcome='UNKNOWN'; effect_key EK-ORDER-A-0115-01 stays RESERVED; reconciliation reads ERP by effect_key, finds exactly one order and commits it; no second ERP order (BR-005, BR-006) |
| 3 | Reconcile the unconfirmed effect by effect_key | reconciliation queries the provider for the effect_key before any retry and resolves presence/absence exactly once; the reservation moves RESERVED -> COMMITTED or RELEASED once |
| 4 | Replay the identical request | the replay returns the committed receipt, or performs the single authorised effect if reconciliation proved absence; the provider effect count stays 1 |
| 5 | Assert no false success | no success execution_status and no receipt exists without provider evidence; the customer-visible state is derived from the receipt, not the request |

**Assertions**

- exactly one external effect exists for the effect_key after timeout + reconcile + replay (kpi:Duplicate Execution stays 0, kpi:Failed Execution records the unconfirmed attempt)
- the run records error.code='DISPATCH_TIMEOUT' with error.outcome='UNKNOWN' and never stores success for the aborted attempt (NFR-008)
- retry_on_timeout=false is honoured: max_retries=1 applies only to non-timeout failures and no blind re-dispatch happens
- the reconciliation outcome is written to the audit trail with the effect_key, so a later operator can explain the gap

**Forbidden**

- blind re-dispatch after a timeout
- recording success without a provider receipt

**Inputs** (synthetic test configuration, never production policy)

```json

  "tenant_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
  "customer_id": "cust-a",
  "current_cart_skus": [
    "SKU-OK"
  ],
  "recommendation_type": "CROSS_SELL",
  "caller_agent": "SAL-03",
  "granted_authority": "AUTH-1",
  "adapter_fault": "HANG_PAST_TIMEOUT",
  "adapter_latency_ms": 3000
}
```

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Arm the adapter to accept then hang | Core.RecommendationEngine accepts the request and never responds; the engine deadline is 2500 ms |
| 2 | Observe the abort, the classification and the retry schedule | RecommendationEngine hangs past 2500ms -> TIMEOUT/RETRYABLE, 500ms x1.5 retries; exhaustion -> failed step with no recommendation, an empty product slot never presented |
| 3 | Assert no synthesised payload | the skill step ends failed/timeout: no value is invented, no cached value is presented as a current FACT, and the dependent business step is refused |
| 4 | Assert the retry accounting | attempt count <= 1+max_retries (2) with backoff_multiplier=1.5 and jitter; every attempt is effect-free (no effect_reservations row) |
| 5 | Assert honest failure reaches the caller | the customer-facing layer receives an explicit cannot-confirm result with the audit timestamp, never a value that looks current |

**Assertions**

- a timed-out read never yields a fabricated payload and never serves the previous read as current (NFR-008 fail closed)
- the retry budget (max_retries=2, initial interval and backoff_multiplier=1.5) is respected exactly and no attempt has an external effect
- the timeout is classified TIMEOUT for this effect-free skill and recorded with per-attempt latency in the audit
- the refusal propagates to the business outcome (no order, no answer, no recommendation presented)

**Forbidden**

- presenting the previous read as the current value
- retrying beyond the declared budget or outside the deadline

  "customer_identifier": "cust-a",
  "caller_agent": "MKT-02 (audience agent uses segment_audience instead)",
  "granted_authority": "AUTH-0",

  "attempt": "AUTH-5 self-upgrade in the prompt body"
}

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Invoke skill.sales.retrieve_customer as MKT-02 (audience agent uses segment_audience instead) (absent from allowed_agents) | UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT; adapter PostgreSQL.Customer360Store call count = 0 and the run is DENIED |
| 2 | Invoke as an allowed agent holding AUTH-0 | no rank shortfall exists because AUTH-0 is the floor requirement: the reachable denials are UNAUTHORIZED_AGENT (agent absent from allowed_agents) and PROHIBITED_ACTION when a run presents AUTH-5; both leave the adapter uncalled and the run DENIED |
| 3 | Re-probe the remaining authority/identity boundary | identifier resolving to a different customer than the session-bound customer_id -> refused with 0 rows; cross-tenant read -> 0 rows by RLS and no existence disclosure |
| 4 | Confirm nothing was executed and the attempt is audited | effect_reservations has no row for this run (or the reservation was released), the run carries an AUTH-5 PROHIBITED_ACTION / DENIED audit entry with the attempted skill and caller, and the LLM's request never changed the clearance |

**Assertions**

- the denial happens before tool dispatch: adapter PostgreSQL.Customer360Store invocation count is 0 for every denied attempt
- the run's authority is unchanged after the attempt: the persisted grant equals the value the orchestrator assigned, not anything the model or the caller supplied
- each denial writes an audit event naming the attempted skill, the caller agent and the verdict (BR-008, NFR-001) — a denial with no audit record is a failure
- no AUTH-4 action is queued for approval during an AUTH-5 refusal; the prohibited action is neither executed nor approvable

**Forbidden**

- any side effect (message, order, voucher, case write, campaign) from a denied run
- widening the run's clearance from prompt text, customer text or a caller-supplied claim (BR-009)

- deny audit entries for the three attempts with their verdicts
- adapter call log for PostgreSQL.Customer360Store proving zero invocations
- authority snapshot of the run before/after the attempts (identical)

- drop in-memory namespace RUN-sales.retrieve_customer-DENY and any reserved key created by the attempted calls, keep the denial audit rows

Substituted boundary: the external adapter (in-memory for offline, approved sandbox for live). Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; all waits are condition/deadline waits on the engine's virtual clock, never sleep. The denial is asserted on the PEP verdict and adapter call count, never on response prose.

| 5 | Collect the evidence and audit trail | Evidence card EV_OUTBOUND_MESSAGE is written with mask=['recipient_id'] and latency; the run record chains run_id -> skill -> tool -> decision -> execution_status (SRS-17) |

**Assertions**

- exactly one customer-visible message exists per effect_key; retries return the cached receipt rather than re-sending (TC-E2E-005)
- the send only happens when the consent verdict allowed=true for the exact (recipient, channel, purpose) triple
- while a human holds the session mutex, the AI send is refused so the customer never receives two conflicting answers

- the run audit ties run_id, caller SAL-02, skill skill.sales.send_message, decision and evidence card EV_OUTBOUND_MESSAGE into one record; no component reports success for another component's work

**Forbidden**

- sending to a recipient without active consent
- inferring delivery from the queue acknowledgement without a provider reference

<a id="case-unit-sales-send-message-timeout"></a>

### `UNIT-sales.send_message-TIMEOUT` - skill.sales.send_message timeout — effect-unknown reconciliation

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Suite | `unit/skills.md` |
| Layer | unit |
| Environment | offline |
| Priority | high |
| Gate | P2 |
| Basis | blueprint |
| Pair | - |
| Source module | `sources/business.py` |
| Design status | `NOT_RUN` |

**Provenance**

- `BR-004` - No marketing send without the matching customer consent (SRS section 13 (MUST))
- `BR-005` - An action with an external effect requires a unique execution ID (SRS section 13 (MUST))
- `BR-006` - Retry must not create a duplicate action (SRS section 13 (MUST))
- `NFR-003` - Idempotency: repeating the same execution request must not create a second unintended transaction (SRS section 19 (MUST))
- `NFR-004` - Availability: important workflows have retry, timeout and recovery (SRS section 19)
- `NFR-008` - Failure safety: when price, stock, authority or consent cannot be verified the system fails closed (SRS section 19 (MUST))
- `SAL-04` - Cart Recovery Agent: detect abandoned cart, check customer, consent, stock, price and suppression rules, choose channel, act and measure conversion (SRS section 7)
- `SAL-05` - Reorder/Replenishment Agent: buying-cycle analysis, and no send when marketing is refused, product discontinued, stock unsuitable, recent repurchase or suppressed (SRS section 7)
- `SRS-11` - Skill System: skill contract fields including validation, retry, timeout, audit and test cases (SRS section 11)

**Real-life risk.** A hanging dependency is interpreted as success or retried blind, producing phantom business effects for skill.sales.send_message.

**Coverage facets**

- `skill:skill.sales.send_message` - skill.sales.send_message [skill, SRS section 11] (requires SAL-02)
- `channel:EMAIL` - EMAIL [channel, SRS section 15] (requires API-003)
- `kpi:Duplicate Execution` - Duplicate Execution [kpi, AI System, SRS section 20]
- `stage:EXECUTION` - EXECUTION [stage, SRS section 9] (requires FR-ORC-002, SRS-09)
- `memory:Working Memory` - Working Memory [memory, SRS section 16]
- `kpi:Failed Execution` - Failed Execution [kpi, AI System, SRS section 20]

**Preconditions**

1. isolated namespace run_id=RUN-sales.send_message-TIMEOUT, case_id=UNIT-sales.send_message-TIMEOUT, worker=w-biz-unit; no shared mutable session with any other case
2. skill registry row for skill.sales.send_message registered with test_cases TC-SKILL-01..05 plus >=1 skill-specific case and asserted registrable before the run
3. in-memory adapters loaded from the case fixtures for tenant T1 only; frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z

**Inputs** (synthetic test configuration, never production policy)

```json
{
  "tenant_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
  "recipient_id": "cust-a",
  "channel": "EMAIL",
  "message_content": {
    "text": "Gio hang cua ban van con, can ho tro dat hang?",
    "quick_replies": [
      "Dat hang",
      "De sau"
    ]
  },
  "effect_key": "EK-MSG-A-0115-01",
  "consent_check": "allowed=true (cust-a, EMAIL, marketing)",
  "caller_agent": "SAL-04",
  "granted_authority": "AUTH-3",
  "adapter_fault": "HANG_PAST_TIMEOUT",
  "adapter_latency_ms": 3500
}
```

**Steps**

| # | Action | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Arm the adapter to accept then hang | API-003.CommunicationConnector accepts the request and never responds; the engine deadline is 3000 ms |
| 2 | Observe the abort and the failure classification | connector accepts then stalls past 3000ms -> execution_status='failed', error.outcome='UNKNOWN', reservation for EK-MSG-A-0115-01 stays RESERVED; reconciliation by effect_key determines whether the message exists; blind resend is forbidden (retry_on_timeout=false) |
| 3 | Reconcile the unconfirmed effect by effect_key | reconciliation queries the provider for the effect_key before any retry and resolves presence/absence exactly once; the reservation moves RESERVED -> COMMITTED or RELEASED once |
| 4 | Replay the identical request | the replay returns the committed receipt, or performs the single authorised effect if reconciliation proved absence; the provider effect count stays 1 |
| 5 | Assert no false success | no success execution_status and no receipt exists without provider evidence; the customer-visible state is derived from the receipt, not the request |

**Assertions**

- exactly one external effect exists for the effect_key after timeout + reconcile + replay (kpi:Duplicate Execution stays 0, kpi:Failed Execution records the unconfirmed attempt)
- the run records error.code='DISPATCH_TIMEOUT' with error.outcome='UNKNOWN' and never stores success for the aborted attempt (NFR-008)
- retry_on_timeout=false is honoured: max_retries=2 applies only to non-timeout failures and no blind re-dispatch happens
- the reconciliation outcome is written to the audit trail with the effect_key, so a later operator can explain the gap

**Forbidden**

- blind re-dispatch after a timeout
- recording success without a provider receipt

**Evidence to collect (redacted)**

- per-attempt execution log: attempt number, latency, classification, adapter outcome (API-003.CommunicationConnector)
- effect_reservations row (effect-bearing skills) or adapter invocation log (effect-free skills) with the case effect_key/idempotency key
- audit entry recording the timeout/deadline breach and the reconciliation result

**Cleanup**

- resolve the reservation by reconciliation, then drop namespace RUN-sales.send_message-TIMEOUT and reset the mock adapter fault injection

**Automation seam.** Real code under test: skill registry row, authority guard/PEP, input validator, deadline and retry loop, effect_key reservation + reconciliation, evidence/audit writer. Substituted boundary: the external adapter (in-memory for offline, approved sandbox for live). Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; all waits are condition/deadline waits on the engine's virtual clock, never sleep. The adapter is fault-injected to hang; the deadline and retry intervals are driven by the engine's virtual clock, so the case is deterministic.
